algorithms.name: Insertion Sort
algorithms.trade_off: very fast on nearly sorted or tiny data, but O(n^2) otherwise

algorithms.name: Bubble Sort
algorithms.trade_off: simple, but almost always beaten by Insertion Sort

algorithms.name: Selection Sort
algorithms.trade_off: always n^2 comparisons, but never more than n-1 swaps

algorithms.name: Merge Sort
algorithms.trade_off: stable with guaranteed O(n log n), but needs O(n) extra memory

algorithms.name: Quick Sort
algorithms.trade_off: in-place and fastest on average, but O(n^2) worst case and not stable

algorithms.name: Heap Sort
algorithms.trade_off: guaranteed O(n log n) with O(1) memory, but slower in practice
